about: Where a native PreToolUse gate intentionally differs from the recorded Node oracle. Every row is a ruling, not an accident. Rulings: D4 (20261011-164349-146w): gates fail closed, so an internal error is deny JSON with exit 0, narrowed by issue #21: the conduit, worktree, msg, sendmessage-response and ah-cli gates log to hook-errors and allow, as in node, while push-guard, mcp-guard, trust-gate and ultra-gate stay closed; D5: the narrow Bash deny list of the self-care gate; 0114 §3.1: no writer_mismatch.

genericDenyText.reason: ah: the <gate> gate hit an internal error and could not check this call, so it was held; see the hook error log.
genericDenyText.systemMessage: ah: a gate could not check this call, so it was held; see the hook error log.
genericDenyText.note: Provisional wording: the rulings fix the behaviour (deny JSON, exit 0), not the text. A gate that already has its own fail-closed text keeps it.

internalError.native: a recorder since ah-simplify: log to hook-errors, allow; it never denies
a recorder since ah-simplify: log to hook-errors, allow; it never denies

internalError.node: logHookError, no output (the user's permission flow), exit 0
internalError.native: log to hook-errors, allow (parity with node)

internalError.node: none: native-only unit, no node oracle; behaviour is pinned by the Rig rows of HooksHostTests.CompoundAllow
internalError.native: log to hook-errors, no output (Claude Code decides as today)

internalError.node: no Node script exists: the unit is native-only
internalError.native: a SendMessage that carries no mail entry marker and no request token is allowed; one that does is denied with the text that says ah could not record the relay

orphanLineOffersAdopt.node: the state block's orphaned-team line ends: `roster.mjs reap` to list, `reap --commit` to remove
orphanLineOffersAdopt.native: the line also says to ask the user and then adopt the team (`ah roster adopt --orchestrator-pid <your pid> --team <name>` via /wrangl:agent-team) before naming `reap` to list and `reap --commit` to remove
orphanLineOffersAdopt.reason: a fresh session that finds an orphan was steered toward deleting it

eventNull.node: stdin `null` parses; reading a property of it throws inside each gate's try, so the internalError row of the gate applies (the self-care gate guards `input &&` and allows)
eventNull.native: a JSON null event is the generic deny for every gate, the self-care gate included

gateInput.node: a gate fed an empty, unreadable, non-JSON or non-object payload, or one with no string tool_name, reads it as an empty event and allows
gateInput.native: deny JSON, exit 0, a constant reason that says the input was unusable and holds no input text; one hook-errors row; advisory hooks unchanged

scriptUnderRoot.node: a script is accepted when its root is the plugin's own or any sibling directory of it
scriptUnderRoot.native: a sibling is accepted only when its .claude-plugin/plugin.json parses and its name equals the own root's byte for byte; any manifest error refuses

identityFlags.node: a restricted role's msg or roster command may name --session, --orchestrator-pid or a session-identity environment prefix
identityFlags.native: denied outside test mode with a constant reason that names the flag class; the Orchestrator, an Ultra-Advisor, a role-less session and test mode are unchanged

trustFileWrites.node: the Reviewer write gate holds only a restricted Reviewer's writes; Write/Edit/MultiEdit of a trust file by any other role is not held
trustFileWrites.native: a Write, Edit, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit whose real path is trusted-homes or trusted-hierarchy-dirs is denied for every session that has a role or is a participant

renderedMessages.node: exception messages and the --from value are written raw into deny reasons and hook-errors rows
renderedMessages.native: each goes through SafeText.Render: escape sequences and control characters removed, JSON-quoted, at most 200 characters

sessionEndForeignPid.about: #155: a pid is the session only when it is this user's process and its recorded start or its command line shows it
sessionEndForeignPid.node: any live pid on the session's up row holds the session, so the end is foreign: no down row, activity kept
sessionEndForeignPid.native: a live pid that is not a harness session (here a plain child process) does not hold it, so the end marks the member down and clears its activity
sessionEndForeignPid.reason: bare pid existence is also true of a recycled pid (the EC1 ghost); the case's fixture stands a non-harness process in for the other session
